title: Re-run capability for Workflow runs
description:
Requesting re-run button/capability for workflow runs.

During development and testing, we have to create a new event every time we want to test a workflow change. Being able to re-run a previous workflow run would significantly speed up the iteration cycle.

title: Ability to limit the LLM/AI invocations per user
description: Right now the limit for AI invocations are organization based, we would need to be able to set consumption/invocation limits per user

title: Categorizing Self Service actions
description: Allow categorizing self service actions for ease of finding appropriate actions for your needs.

title: Include stable action_id in GET Action Runs API
description: Exposing the stable action_id in the action runs response will ensure long-term data consistency and reliable analytics.

title: Disallow saving actions with no execute permissions
description:
Currently, execute permissions can be removed entirely, which allows an action to be saved with no execute permissions at all. We need a product safeguard to prevent this by either:

Disallowing actions from being saved without any execute permissions, or

Automatically retaining the Admin role as a default execute permission.

description:

This allows multiple agents to run in parallel without conflicts, but requires using the same filtering logic across all agents to avoid unintended filtering.

title: Modify Payload/Inputs for 'Waiting for approval' Self-Service Actions
description:
Currently, once a user initiates a self-service action that needs approval, the action's payload or inputs are fixed. Approvers are unable to change the action's specifics and they can only accept or reject it. 

I suggest before giving final approval, approvers will be able to make any necessary changes to the payload or inputs, potentially reducing the number of rounds of back-and-forth correspondence required between initiators and approvers to modify payloads and inputs.

title: Ability to specify the source of an API change (updatedByAlias/createdByAlias)
description:
We now have multiple locations where we are using the API to update specific blueprints. Having all changes to blueprints made through the API under "Rest API" is too vague for us to know where specifically the change came from. It would be nice if we could include a name of the source in our blueprint change payload and then be able to see this reflect in the audit logs.

title: Add conditionals based on bool input
description:
I want to be able based on bool input to populate other property or hide it/grey out. For example if input1 true create array to select from in input2 else hide input2

This way we can add logic based on input boolean and use one action to perform complex workflows

title: I want to be able to use multiple backends for one self service action
description:
As an example: I have different GH actions configured for provisioning resources on AWS depending on the resource requested:

- Action A: To provision an EC2 instance

- Action B: To provision an S3 bucket

- Action C: To provision an AWS user

- Action D: To provision a lambda function

- Action E: To provision a Postgres DB

I have a single SSA, "Provision AWS Resource" which contains several advanced inputs which are visible or disappear based on the resource type selected. Due to Port's current setup, I have to combine these 5 GH actions into one since the SSA can only trigger one backend.

title: Historical Reporting for Deleted Entities
description:
Port currently only displays entities that exist in the catalog. Users need the ability to generate historical reports that include deleted entities, particularly for:

Tracking entity counts over time (including deleted entities)

Visualizing entity duration/lifetime after deletion

Analyzing trends for entities with timer properties that expire automatically

Current Gap: Line charts and dashboards only reflect current entities; deleted entities are only available in the audit log (limited to 1,000 records) with no visualization capabilities.

Requested Solution: Enable historical reporting

title: Discussions & Comments on entities
description:
Ask questions, discuss, and make decisions within context. 

Allow developers to discuss and comment on different entities directly in Port.

title: Bulk self-service actions on entities
description: It would be great to have an option to do bulk actions(day2 and DELETE) on entities

title: Steps in Port Self-Service Action Form
description:
As a developer using Port's self-service action form,

I want the ability to collapse the form into distinct sections such as network configuration, security configuration, and IAM role,

So that I can more easily navigate and digest the information, focusing on specific areas as needed based on my answers.
